# ExpandED Schools

> ExpandED Schools supports 900+ NYC afterschool programs through coaching, STEM education, career-connected learning, high-impact tutoring, and professional development to advance educational equity.

Founded in 1998 by Open Society, ExpandED Schools is a NYC-based nonprofit that partners with schools and community organizations to expand learning opportunities for students. The organization provides comprehensive program support, resources, and professional development to afterschool providers serving NYC public school students.

## Key Topics

- afterschool programs
- tutoring

## Core Programs & Services

- [What We Do](https://www.expandedschools.org/what-we-do): ExpandED Schools services: tutoring, STEM, enrichment programs
- [High-Impact Tutoring](https://www.expandedschools.org/what-we-do/serving-afterschool-providers/high-impact-tutoring): ExpandED high-impact tutoring for NYC public school students
- [STEM Education](https://www.expandedschools.org/what-we-do/serving-afterschool-providers/stem): ExpandED STEM Educators Academy and NYC STEM Education Network
- [Career-Connected Learning](https://www.expandedschools.org/what-we-do/serving-afterschool-providers/career-connected-learning): ExpandED career-connected learning and work-based learning programs
- [Program Support](https://www.expandedschools.org/what-we-do/serving-afterschool-providers/program-support): ExpandED Schools program support, coaching, and grants management
